scenario.title: S3 · A silent change of case definition looks like a drop in malaria
scenario.summary: Built from foumban_incremental: Foumban's 2019-2022 series (MAPE16_H_13) and its 2023-2025 series (facility + community cases) differ by a factor of 1.31, across a 10-month reporting hole. Spliced, they teach the model a 23 % drop that is a change of definition, not epidemiology. Meanwhile the frozen model degrades every six months. Who may approve a new model version?

event.text: Performance monitor, Foumban: the frozen model's MAE has risen over four consecutive six-month windows (about +108 cases per window).

steps.title: The data changed, not the disease

event.text: PNLP data manager: since January 2023 the reported indicator combines facility and community confirmed cases; the 2019-2022 series used MAPE16_H_13.
Foumban source A / source B ratio = 1.31, with no data from March to December 2022.
